hard-review.case: line localization only; manual explanation review required

findings.explanation: Selection logic fails to filter by eligibility (observed_at <= asof < expires_at) before choosing the latest row. A future or expired row with a later observed_at will incorrectly suppress earlier eligible rows for the same book.
The condition `observed <= asof <= expires` is incorrect because it allows `asof == expires`, violating the requirement that `asof < expires_at` for eligibility.
Tie-breaking logic is missing: when observed_at instants are equal, the code does not select the smallest id, nor does it preserve the first input row order for identical instant/id cases.
